_doc: docs/META.md §6-§7 (product-lead, revision 2026-10-04; consistency audit round 1 2026-10-05; final consistency pass 2026-10-05: Bridge pool 10000 -> 6500). Parameters only; formulas in META. Bot module is pure: reads only this file and (eventId|weekId, t0, t, L0, level difficulty table); never imports economy.json or the save (BUSINESS E8, R-14).

rng._doc: R(a,b,c) = first mulberry32 output of seed hash(eventOrWeekId, a, b, c) / 2^32; only + - * / and comparisons (bit-identical across engines).

wobblyBridge._doc: Split = floor(pool / finishers). prizePoolCoins 6500 (was 10000): expected finisher share must stay < first +5 price (economy.json outOfMoves.offerCosts[0] = 900) for every L0 (15-50 and every Master Mode start 11-50), incl. finisherExtras.coins and every liveOps override; with this bot model the pool cap is 6863 (worst windows L0 44/45/49 ~852 at 6500). config:validate error bridge_share_cap (META §6.2 Koruma). Payout time = min(deadline (extended by the player's level started before it), max(playerDoneTime, lastBotEventTime)). Coin continue offered only if runSpend + price <= bridgeSpendCapCoins (R-16; same key as BUSINESS §4.5).

bot._doc: p = clamp(skill * difficultyFactor[d_k], min, max); d_k = original difficulty of level (L0 + k - 1), Master Mode order after 50.

wobblyBridge._docLiveOps: maxBridgesPerDay: null = no daily limit; else max runs joined per local calendar day (counted at join t0). finisherExtras: null or { coins?, boosters? } given to the player on reaching plank 7, on top of the pool share; pool split and bot model unchanged (META §6.1).

masterLeague._docMultipliers: pointsMultiplier M applies to player win points and bot point increments alike (BUSINESS E8). weekendMultiplier: null or { factor, addPoints, difficulties: [easy|normal|hard|superhard], appliesTo: 'playerAndBots' (only allowed value) }; weekend = UTC Sat 00:00 -> Mon 00:00 of the league week. Player points = floor((pts*factor + addPoints) * M); bots: kappa = M * kappa_w, kappa_w = sum over levels 11..50 of (pts*f+a) / sum of pts; P_i(t) = floor(sum_j kappa_j * (B_i(u_{j+1}) - B_i(u_j))) (META §7.1, §7.3 item 4).
masterLeague._doc: groupId = hash(weekId, installId). Master Mode wins score by original difficulty.

bot._doc: W = tierMultiplier * 100 * u^2, u = R(i,0,0); W' = W * (1 - joinFraction); profile p = floor(5 * R(i,0,1)); P(t) = floor(W' * g_p(x) / 1000), g_p = linear interpolation on curveTable[p] (21 points, permille, x step 0.05). curveExponentsDoc is documentation only.

liveOps._doc: LiveOps theme window [startUtc, endUtc) as ISO 8601 UTC strings; null = no theme. Inside the window, keys under overrides replace the same keys of wobblyBridge (prizePoolCoins, cooldownMinutes, maxBridgesPerDay, finisherExtras) and masterLeague (pointsMultiplier, weekendMultiplier). A Bridge run freezes the values in force at its join time t0. Pool overrides must pass the META §6.2 check (expected share + finisherExtras.coins < 900 for every L0; pool cap 6863 with the current bot model; BUSINESS §4.5-8). META §6.1, §7.1; BUSINESS §7.
